nodes.summary: A class of groups $X$ is a property of groups that is invariant under isomorphism: if a group $H$ belongs to $X$ and $K$ is a group isomorphic to $H$, then $K$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Isomorphism-closed class of groups

nodes.summary: A class of groups $X$ is solubly saturated (a composition class) if, for every finite group $G$ with soluble radical $R$, whenever the Frattini subgroup $\Phi(R)$ of $R$ is normal in $G$ and $G/\Phi(R)$ belongs to $X$, the group $G$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Solubly saturated class

nodes.summary: A class of groups $X$ is a formation if it contains the trivial group, for every finite group $G$ in $X$ and every normal subgroup $N$ of $G$ the quotient $G/N$ belongs to $X$, and for every finite group $G$ with normal subgroups $N_1, N_2$ such that $G/N_1$ and $G/N_2$ belong to $X$, the quotient $G/(N_1 \cap N_2)$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Formation of finite groups

nodes.summary: A class of groups $X$ is hereditary if every subgroup of a finite group in $X$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Hereditary class of groups

nodes.summary: A class of groups $X$ is radical if, for every finite group $G$, every normal subgroup of $G$ belongs to $X$ whenever $G$ does, and whenever $N_1, N_2$ are normal subgroups of $G$ that belong to $X$, their product $N_1 N_2$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Radical (Fitting) class

nodes.summary: A subgroup $R$ of a group $G$ is the soluble radical of $G$ if $R$ is a soluble normal subgroup of $G$ that contains every soluble normal subgroup of $G$.
nodes.title: Soluble radical

nodes.summary: For a class of groups $X$, a group $G$ and a subgroup $N$ of $G$, this holds when $N$ is normal in $G$ and the quotient group $G/N$ belongs to $X$.
nodes.title: Quotient lying in a class

nodes.summary: It is not true that every radical hereditary formation of finite groups is a composition formation: some class of groups that is a formation, a radical class and a hereditary class is not solubly saturated.
nodes.title: Radical hereditary formations need not be composition formations

nodes.summary: The statement that every radical hereditary formation of finite groups is a composition formation: every class of groups that is a formation, a radical class and a hereditary class is solubly saturated.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 12.7 (Vasil'ev)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
